fit: corn oil as common injection vehicle
assessment: Tamoxifen was dissolved in corn oil. Age-matched vehicle controls also received corn oil. Behavioral contrasts compare the model with its vehicle-exposed controls and do not isolate corn oil.

fit: purchased proanthocyanidin and experimental cell viability
assessment: Grape seed appears among natural proanthocyanidin sources. Reagent botanical origin is unreported and the endpoints are cell viability and apoptosis, without a rigidity measurement.

fit: saffron narrative review with opposing sleep references
assessment: The cardiovascular review mentions hypnotic observations and lists possible insomnia. Follow the underlying animal study and safety table separately. No new clinical symptom contrast.
The review addresses curcumin structure and separate derived synthetic inhibitors. Enzyme inhibition does not identify a ground turmeric Parkinson pain outcome.

fit: coffee or caffeine context in adenosine and dementia literature
assessment: Caffeine and coffee are discussed around cognition and aging. Exposure scope differs across studies and the review reports no brewed coffee Parkinson fatigue comparison.

fit: isolated cinnamaldehyde and vertical climbing in fly models
assessment: Cinnamaldehyde improved vertical climbing in male Tau-model flies and did not clearly improve it in wild-type. Alzheimer-related fly model, isolated constituent and climbing differ from culinary cinnamon and Parkinson walking speed.

fit: powdered fermented grape skin and motor-related fly phenotypes
assessment: Approximately half of mutant flies on standard food showed abnormal wing posture. Higher amounts of powdered fermented grape skin reduced the abnormal proportion. No animal or human rigidity scale and no frozen whole grape contrast.

fit: olive oil named in Mediterranean diet background
assessment: Olive oil is part of the introductory dietary description. The actual comparison administered grape skin powder or resveratrol in fly food, without an olive-oil arm or clinical bradykinesia measure.

fit: coffee xanthines and alertness or drowsiness
assessment: The review names coffee as a source of caffeine and reports pharmacological contexts for alertness. It supplies no beverage-specific fatigue severity estimate.

fit: green tea constituent context and fatigue distinction
assessment: Theophylline and other xanthines are described with tea as a natural source. This does not compare brewed green tea and Parkinson fatigue.

fit: induced sleep separates saffron aqueous extract from purified constituents
assessment: Injected safranal and the highest aqueous extract level increased pentobarbital-induced sleep in mice, whereas crocin showed no measurable hypnotic effect in this assay. No spontaneous or clinical insomnia measurement.

fit: toxicology review traces insomnia counts to an existing petal trial
assessment: The insomnia row cites Basti et al. and gives three events on each arm, p=1.00. The review is a secondary manifestation of the existing petal-versus-fluoxetine trial for this comparison.

fit: wild-grape compound and experimental cell autophagy
assessment: The original abstract reports reporter and SH-SY5Y cell findings for isolated amurensin G from Vitis amurensis. It does not measure stiffness or compare frozen grapes.
